about: The Harmony 350's test setup, todo-compile-350.md 3.1: the shared test setup's seven devices plus the Knoll HDP-1100, the eighth device the Harmony 650 ran, so every device key holds a short and a long press device; its one activity is the shared setup's TV kijken; and five favourite channels on the KPN, the last with a leading zero. Which device goes on which key is not part of this file's format: the device keys short and long, TV (top left) LG TV and Plasma, Cable (top right) KPN and Kodi, DVD (bottom left) Denon and Sony HT, Aux (bottom right) Switch and Knoll.
